answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a time-locked stake registry: voting weight comes from escrow that matures after a cooldown. A zephyr of fresh wallets carries zero weight until each ages, and a whole cohort counts as one voice because it shares a backer. Audits trace any sudden tide of new identities to its funding source; a confirmed clone forfeits its onyx escrow. The attacker pays twice, capital frozen through the cooldown plus forfeiture risk, while each unit of influence costs the same as an honest agent's. Flooding with sybils inflates locked capital, never their share.
